Results for "date picker" (7)

name:        useCalendarDays
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Calendar
description: Builds the day grid for one month: every date to show, including the previous and next months' days that fill the first and last weeks, grouped into weeks, plus localized weekday header names that start on weekStartsOn. It is the layout Calendar uses, for a custom month view such as a compact availability grid or a mini calendar. It returns data only: rendering, selection, keyboard navigation and the grid's accessibility semantics are the caller's.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useCalendarDays

name:        useCalendarConstraints
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Calendar
description: Provides date constraint validation for calendar views and custom range pickers. It combines boundary dates, span limits measured from an in-progress range start, and custom rules (such as weekly closures or blackout dates) into an isDateDisabled predicate. Calendar uses it internally to disable day buttons; use it directly when building bespoke scheduling interfaces or range pickers.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useCalendarConstraints

name:        usePowerSearchConfig
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/PowerSearch
description: Memoizes a PowerSearch configuration built from typed field definitions and returns it along with an applyFilters function for client-side filtering. Automatically maps field types (string, number, boolean, date, enum, etc.) to their canonical operators and provides an efficient predicate evaluator to filter datasets.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook usePowerSearchConfig

name:        useTableFiltering
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Table plugin that adds inline column filters with popover or inline controls. Pairs with useTableFilterState for managed state. Supports text, select, multi-select, date, and number filter types via PowerSearch field definitions.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useTableFiltering

name:        useCalendarNavigation
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Calendar
description: Manages visible month state and pagination for calendar components. It provides previous/next month stepping, localized month-year header strings, and pending focus tracking so keyboard arrow navigation seamlessly moves focus across month boundaries into the adjacent month. Use it directly when composing custom calendar headers, pager controls, or dual-month availability pickers.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useCalendarNavigation

name:        useTableColumnSettings
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Headless column visibility and ordering management for Table. Provides filtered columns, toggle helpers, and pre-built MultiSelector options for a column picker UI.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useTableColumnSettings

name:        useTableColumnSettingsState
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Table
description: Headless column visibility and ordering state management for Table. Manages which columns are active, provides toggle and reset operations, and produces a config object that feeds directly into useTableColumnSettings. Renderer-agnostic and pairs with any column picker UI.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useTableColumnSettingsState
